t: Highway to Heaven: The Last Assignment
d: An errant angel has been on probation for two centuries because he's always breaking the rules.

t: Highway to Heaven: The Bind the Wounds
d: A father attempts to have a memorial made to commemorate his son who was killed in Vietnam.

t: Highway to Heaven: Heaven on Earth
d: Mark asks Jonathan to help erase everything bad that's happened to him recently. Mark's idea is to create his own vision of heaven on Earth.
A dying woman was forced to leave a son behind in the Soviet Union during World War II.
Tragedy occurs when a Neo-Nazi disputes the Holocaust with the son of a death camp survivor.
Jonathan and Mark assist a novelist who's given up. Also, they motivate the man's grandson, who has yet to tap into his literary potential.
A reporter uncovers a secret about the past of a woman who runs a home for unwed mothers.
While working as a substitute teacher at a high school, Jonathan assigns an overweight girl to tutor a troubled baseball star.

t: Highway to Heaven: A Special Love - Part 1
d: Jonathan and Mark persuade a youngster with Down's Syndrome to join the Special Olympics.

t: Highway to Heaven: A Special Love - Part 2
d: Jonathan and Mark's friend Scotty wants to adopt the boy with Down's Syndrome. A custody battle occurs with the biological parents.

t: Highway to Heaven: For the Love of Larry
d: Jonathan and Mark rescue victims trapped in a car, thanks to a helpful dog.

t: Highway to Heaven: Another Kind of War, Another Kind of Peace
st: Another Kind of War, Another Kind of Peace
d: A man whose son died in Vietnam learns that he has an Amerasian grandson.

t: Highway to Heaven: That's Our Dad
d: A children's-show host has a warm-hearted TV persona but is actually a cynic at heart.

t: Highway to Heaven: Love at Second Sight
d: Another angel is upset that Jonathan has been assigned to find a mate for his widow.

t: Highway to Heaven: Love and Marriage - Part 1
d: Bickering couples go on a trip to learn what it was that brought them together.

t: Highway to Heaven: Love and Marriage - Part 2
d: Jonathan and Mark work to keep the three couples together.

t: Highway to Heaven: Code Name: FREAK
d: A 12-year-old genius at college is treated like a social outcast by his less intelligent but more socially adept schoolmates.

t: Highway to Heaven: Man to Man
d: A wealthy businessman would like to bridge the gap between himself and his son.
